## Description
This figure displays three plots comparing the objective function values of different style transfer networks over iterations of L-BFGS. Each plot corresponds to a different image size: 256x256, 512x512, and 1024x1024. The series are labeled as "Content Image" (red dashed line), "Ours" (green dashed line), and "[10]" (blue line with markers). The "Content Image" series is consistently the highest, followed by "Ours", and "[10]" is the lowest across all plots.
